source_refs.note: Range of the projectile: a main subheading of 2.6 Projectile motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 34-37.

blocks.text: Projectile horizontal direction mein jo maximum distance tay karti hai, use range kehte hain.
Range R nikalne ke liye velocity ke horizontal component ko poore time of flight se multiply karte hain (kyun ke horizontal velocity constant hai):

blocks.title: Do You Know ?
blocks.text: 45° se kam angle par projectile ki height bhi kam hoti hai aur range bhi. 45° se zyada angle par height zyada hoti hai lekin range phir kam ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Ek hi speed se 30, 45 aur 60 degrees par fire ki gayi teen projectiles ki height aur range. 60 degrees wala rasta sab se ooncha, 45 degrees wala sab se door, aur 30 aur 60 degrees wale raste ek hi point par girte hain.
blocks.caption: 30°, 45° aur 60° par fire ki gayi projectiles ke raste (Do You Know; kitab ke graph ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text_alt: or R = vi cos θ × 2vi sin θ / g
or R = (vi²/g) 2 sin θ cos θ

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon projectiles ki speed ek hai, sirf angle alag hai. Range R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ: 45° par sin 90° = 1, is liye range sab se zyada. 30° aur 60° ke liye sin 60° aur sin 120° barabar hain, is liye dono ek hi jagah girti hain, lekin 60° wali zyada height tak jati hai (h = vi² sin²θ / 2g) aur hawa mein zyada der rehti hai.
2 sin θ cos θ = sin 2θ hota hai, is liye range velocity of projection (phenkne ki velocity) aur angle of projection (phenkne ke angle) par depend karti hai:
Sab se zyada range ke liye sin 2θ = 1 hona chahiye, yani:
Air resistance projectile ki aage ki motion ko dheema karti hai aur velocity vi kam karti hai; vi kam hone se range bhi kam ho jati hai.

Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke air resistance poori flight mein constant (ek jaisi) nahi rehti. Jaise jaise cheez dheemi hoti hai, us par air resistance bhi kam hoti jati hai. Is liye cheez aahista aahista rukti hai aur girte waqt bhi aahista tez hoti hai. Result: rasta (trajectory) poora parabola nahi rehta balke ek taraf jhuka (skewed) hota hai, aur utarna charhne se zyada seedha (steep) hota hai.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Air friction (hawa ki ragar) ho to high speed (tez) projectile ka rasta parabola wale raste se chhota reh jata hai (pehle zameen par aa jati hai).

blocks.alt: Ek hi launch se do raste: ideal path, yani symmetric (dono taraf barabar) parabola, aur air friction ke saath actual path, jo kam ooncha jata hai aur ideal raste se pehle zameen par aata hai.
blocks.caption: High speed projectile ka ideal path aur actual path (For Your Information; kitab ke graph ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono raste ek hi speed aur angle se shuru hote hain. Air resistance speed kam karti rehti hai, is liye actual path kam height tak jata hai aur range kam hoti hai.

blocks.title: Example 2.5
blocks.problem: Ek ball 30 m s⁻¹ ki speed se horizontal se 30° oopar ki direction mein phenki jati hai. Woh kitni height tak jati hai, time of flight kitna hai, aur horizontal range kitni hai?
steps: Shuru ke components: vix = vi cos θ = 30 m s⁻¹ × cos 30° = 25.98 m s⁻¹; viy = vi sin θ = 30 m s⁻¹ × sin 30° = 15 m s⁻¹
Time of flight: t = 2vi sin θ / g = (2 × 15 m s⁻¹)/(9.8 m s⁻²) = 3.1 s
Height: h = vi² sin²θ / 2g = (30 m s⁻¹)²(0.5)² / 19.6 m s⁻² = 225/19.6 m = 11.5 m
Range: R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ = (vi²/g) sin 60° = (30 m s⁻¹)² × 0.866 / 9.8 m s⁻² = 779.4/9.8 m
blocks.answer: h = 11.5 m, t = 3.1 s, R = 79.53 m (taqreeban 79.5 m)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne range 89.53 m chhapi hai. Khud calculate karein: (30)² = 900, 900 × 0.866 = 779.4, aur 779.4 / 9.8 = 79.53. Is liye sahi range 79.53 m (taqreeban 79.5 m) hai; kitab mein 7 ki jagah 8 chhap gaya hai.

blocks.caption: Projectile ke formulas
rows: R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ; 45° par sab se zyada

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke angle θ aur (90° - θ) par phenki gayi projectile ki range ek jaisi hoti hai. Sab se oonche point tak pohanchne ka time bhi nikalein.
blocks.explanation: R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ. Angle (90° - θ) ke liye sin 2(90° - θ) = sin (180° - 2θ) = sin 2θ, is liye dono angles (jaise 30° aur 60°) ki range barabar hai. Sab se oonche point par vfy = 0, to vfy = vi sin θ - gt se t = vi sin θ / g; yeh time of flight ka aadha hai.

items: Horizontal throw: x = vx t, y = ½gt²; dono motions ek doosre se independent. Angle θ par projectile: vfx = vi cos θ, vfy = vi sin θ - gt, v = √(vfx² + vfy²), tan φ = vfy/vfx.
h = vi² sin²θ / 2g; t = 2vi sin θ / g; R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ, 45° par sab se zyada; air resistance height aur range kam karti hai aur raste ko jhuka deti hai (utarna zyada steep).
